translation: Anyway, [#W20Haruhi] should be satisfied with that.

It's unfortunate but, I don't think it'll go so
smoothly.
What do you mean, Koizumi…?
Well, please think about it for a moment.

Of the mysterious phenomena the computer
society encountered, three more remain.

Considering this is Miss Suzumiya, I somehow
doubt it'll be so easy.

Damn it. There's no reason to contest
anything Koizumi said.

Instead, my seasoned intuition is giving me a
stern warning—
"This is just the beginning.”

…Nagato, I just want to make sure of one
thing.
What?

That so-called data lifeform—are there any
others?
They exist.
Currently, the confirmable population is—
H-hold on! You don't have to say it!

I was dangerously close to hearing something
I didn't want to know.

This is my personal opinion but, if we're done
after only three,[#W30] I'd rather do more.
Huh…?!
How long are you gonna make me wait, Kyon?!
Haruhi…

And I'll tell you what,[#W20] I'm not happy with this at
all!

To begin with, what I want is a mystery worthy
of the new seven wonders.

If this ends up like some third rate mystery,
I'd rather not have a mystery at all!
Got that? If so, get moving now!
What a mess…

This Haruhi… Far from being satisfied, she's
getting even more fired up instead.
Koizumi—what's next?
Of course, Miss Suzumiya.

Chronologically—the case of the piano in the
music room. Isn't that perfect?
Then let's go for that!

This time, I'll gaze upon real unnatural
phenomena with my own eyes!
About Haruhi
